Hereafter in all cases where the amount due on any mortgage or judgment entered of
   record, together with interest and cost, shall have been paid to the legal holder
   or holders thereof, and the judgment bond, or note, or mortgage, together with the
   accompanying bonds, if any, duly endorsed in the presence of two witnesses, that the
   same are satisfied and discharged, shall be produced to the prothonotary or recorder
   having charge of the records of such mortgages and judgments respectively, it shall
   be the duty of such officer, for the fee of seventy-five cents in the case of a mortgage,
   and twenty-five cents in the case of a judgment, to enter satisfaction on the record
   of such liens, and to file among the papers in their respective offices the judgment,
   notes, bills, mortgages and bonds respectively, which shall remain filed thereafter,
   for the benefit of all parties interested therein:  Provided, That no such satisfaction
   shall be entered until after a certificate from the president judge or the district
   judge of the proper county, allowing the same, which certificate shall also be produced
   and filed with the papers as aforesaid.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Satisfaction of Mortgages›PA ST 21 P.S. § 702. Validation of previous satisfactions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Satisfaction of Mortgages › PA ST 21 P.S. § 702. Validation of previous satisfactions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 702. Validation of previous satisfactions (2023)
content:
All satisfactions of mortgages heretofore entered in good faith, at the instance of
   any mortgagee or assignee of record, on the record of any mortgagee,1by virtue of an authorization acknowledging the receipt of the amount due on the
   mortgage, or a statement of the mortgagee's or assignee's desire to have said mortgage
   satisfied, or in any other manner other than by a satisfaction entered by the mortgagee
   or assignee of record personally or by the recorder of deeds or any other person acting
   under a letter or power of attorney duly executed and acknowledged, are hereby declared
   to be good and valid and to operate as a complete satisfaction of such mortgage, in
   like manner as if said mortgage had been personally satisfied by the mortgagee on
   the margin of the record as provided by law:  Provided, That said acknowledgment of
   the receipt of the amount due, or a statement of the mortgagee's or assignee's desire
   to have said mortgage satisfied, shall have been duly signed and acknowledged by said
   mortgagee or assignee of record in due form of law and recorded as mortgages are now
   recorded, and the record of such instrument or a duly certified copy thereof shall
   be as good evidence as the original receipt or statement duly proven in any court
   of justice.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 711. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 711. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 711. Definitions (2023)
content: As used in this act,

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 716. Fee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 716. Fee
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 716. Fee (2023)
content:
The fee for recording a satisfaction piece shall be two dollars and fifty cents ($2.50),
   exclusive of any State tax now levied or that may hereafter be levied on recorded
   instruments.  The council of any city of the first class may, by ordinance, establish any other
   fees as it may determine to be proper to cover the costs of the recording and the
   maintenance of the records of satisfied mortgages.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Satisfaction of Mortgages›PA ST 21 P.S. § 700. Satisfaction of mortgages to commonwealth
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Satisfaction of Mortgages › PA ST 21 P.S. § 700. Satisfaction of mortgages to commonwealth
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 700. Satisfaction of mortgages to commonwealth (2023)
content:
Whenever, heretofore or hereafter, mortgages have been or shall be duly executed and
   delivered to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, or to any officer of the Commonwealth,
   for its use, and have been or shall be recorded in any county or counties of the State,
   the Attorney General, or other officer or officers of the Commonwealth having custody
   thereof, shall, upon payment in full of said mortgage or mortgages, or the bonds,
   notes, or other writings obligatory which said mortgages were given to secure, surrender
   and deliver the same to the mortgagor or obligor therein, or a duly authorized agent;
   and the Attorney General, upon payment of the proper costs and charges, together with
   accrued interest, shall acknowledge satisfaction of said mortgage upon the record
   thereof, and cause the same to be satisfied of record, either acting by himself or
   through a person duly authorized by his letter of attorney to act for him.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Satisfaction of Mortgages›PA ST 21 P.S. § 701. Power of attorney to recorder of deeds to enter satisfaction
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Satisfaction of Mortgages › PA ST 21 P.S. § 701. Power of attorney to recorder of deeds to enter satisfaction
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 701. Power of attorney to recorder of deeds to enter satisfaction (2023)
content:
In all cases where any owner or holder of a mortgage, having legal power to satisfy
   the same, has heretofore executed and delivered, or may hereafter execute and deliver,
   a power of attorney authorizing the recorder of deeds of the county in which such
   mortgage is recorded, in office at the time of such execution and delivery, by his
   official title to enter satisfaction of such mortgage upon the record, and such satisfaction
   has not been entered, such power of attorney when duly recorded shall be a sufficient
   authority to any subsequent recorder of deeds of the same county to enter satisfaction
   of such mortgage upon the record thereof.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 712. Satisfaction piece; recording; execution; effect
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 712. Satisfaction piece; recording; execution; effect
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 712. Satisfaction piece; recording; execution; effect (2023)
content:
Every mortgagee shall, upon receipt of payment of the mortgage debt and tender of
   satisfaction and filing costs, at the request of the mortgagor or owner of the mortgaged
   premises, enter of record in the office where the mortgage is recorded a duly executed
   satisfaction piece to be phrased substantially as provided in the form set out in
   section seven of this act,1and acknowledged as provided by law.  The satisfaction piece when recorded shall forever thereafter discharge, defeat
   and release the lien and debt of the mortgage.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-1. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-1. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-1. Definitions (2023)
content: As used in this act:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 713. Contents of satisfaction piece
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 713. Contents of satisfaction piece
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 713. Contents of satisfaction piece (2023)
content:
Every satisfaction piece shall contain the name of the mortgagor and mortgagee, the
   date and amount of the mortgage, a reference by book and page (or appropriate designation
   in the case of microfilm recording) to the record of the original mortgage, a brief
   description of the real estate, and any assignment or assignments thereof.  The satisfaction piece shall be accompanied, on presentation for recording, by the
   original mortgage instrument.  Nothing herein contained shall impose liability on any city or county of the first
   class for any mistake, error or inaccuracy found in any satisfaction piece filed by
   any mortgagee which shall appear complete and correct at the time of its filing.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Satisfaction of Mortgages›PA ST 21 P.S. § 705. Notice requirement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Satisfaction of Mortgages › PA ST 21 P.S. § 705. Notice requirement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 705. Notice requirement (2023)
content:
A bank, savings bank, savings and loan association or other lending institution holding
   a residential mortgage shall send written notification by first class mail to the
   mortgagor when the mortgage has been fully paid.  Any moneys remaining in any escrow account established for the payment of taxes
   or insurance premiums shall be returned within 30 days to the mortgagor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 714. Indexing of satisfaction piece
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 714. Indexing of satisfaction piece
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 714. Indexing of satisfaction piece (2023)
content:
The recording officer shall properly index all satisfaction pieces against the name
   of the mortgagee or last assignee, as each is indicated in the satisfaction piece,
   and the recording officer shall indicate the recording of the satisfaction piece in
   the mortgage record.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 715. Satisfaction by order or decree
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 715. Satisfaction by order or decree
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 715. Satisfaction by order or decree (2023)
content:
This act1shall not affect or impair any other act, or any rule of civil procedure promulgated
   by the Supreme Court of the Commonwealth, which provides for the satisfaction or discharge
   of a mortgage by order or decree of any court upon payment of the fee prescribed in
   section six hereof.2The recording officer shall accept for recording a copy of the order or decree certified
   by the prothonotary, and shall index and indicate the same in the record as is herein
   provided for a satisfaction piece.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-4. Form of satisfaction piece
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-4. Form of satisfaction piece
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-4. Form of satisfaction piece (2023)
content: (a) Form of satisfaction piece for use by natural persons.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-8. Fee for recording
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-8. Fee for recording
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-8. Fee for recording (2023)
content:
The fee for recording a satisfaction piece shall be four dollars and fifty cents ($4.50),
   exclusive of any State tax now levied or that may hereafter be levied on recorded
   instruments.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-2. Satisfaction piece, effect of recording
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-2. Satisfaction piece, effect of recording
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-2. Satisfaction piece, effect of recording (2023)
content:
Every mortgagee may enter of record in the office where the mortgage is recorded a
   duly executed satisfaction piece which shall forever thereafter satisfy and discharge
   the lien of the mortgage referred to therein;  however, in every county that microfilms
   the mortgage, upon direction of the recorder of deeds the mortgagee shall satisfy
   and discharge the lien of the mortgage by means of a satisfaction piece.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-6. Mistakes, liability
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-6. Mistakes, liability
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-6. Mistakes, liability (2023)
content:
Nothing herein contained shall impose liability on any recording officer or any political
   subdivision of the Commonwealth for any mistake, error or inaccuracy found in any
   satisfaction piece recorded or filed for recording.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Cities and Counties of First Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 717. Form of satisfaction piece
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Cities and Counties of First Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 717. Form of satisfaction piece
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 717. Form of satisfaction piece (2023)
content: (a) Form of Individual Satisfaction Piece;  Complete Satisfaction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-3. Satisfaction piece, contents, execution, acknowledgment, mortgage accompanying
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-3. Satisfaction piece, contents, execution, acknowledgment, mortgage accompanying
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-3. Satisfaction piece, contents, execution, acknowledgment, mortgage accompanying (2023)
content:
Every satisfaction piece shall be in substantially the form provided in section 4
   of this act1and shall contain the names of the mortgagor, mortgagee and of the last assignee
   of mortgagee, if any, the date and the original principal amount of the mortgage,
   an accurate reference by book and page (or other appropriate recording reference)
   to the place where the mortgage and the last assignment thereof are recorded or filed
   for recording, and a brief description of or a statement of the location of the mortgaged
   real estate, and shall be executed and acknowledged by or on behalf of the mortgagee.  The satisfaction piece shall be accompanied, upon presentation for recording, by
   the original or a certified copy of the mortgage instrument.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-7. Other statutes or rule of civil procedure
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-7. Other statutes or rule of civil procedure
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-7. Other statutes or rule of civil procedure (2023)
content:
This act shall not affect or impair any other act, or any rule of civil procedure
   promulgated by the Supreme Court of the Commonwealth, which provides for the satisfaction
   or discharge of a mortgage in any manner other than as prescribed herein.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Counties of Second to Eighth Class›PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-5. Recording; indexing; reference on mortgage record
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Counties of Second to Eighth Class › PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-5. Recording; indexing; reference on mortgage record
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 720-5. Recording; indexing; reference on mortgage record (2023)
content:
The recording officer shall enter of record and properly index all satisfaction pieces
   against the name of the mortgagee or last assignee, as each is indicated in the satisfaction
   piece, and the recording officer shall indicate the recording of the satisfaction
   piece by an accurate reference placed on the record of the instrument satisfied thereby,
   or when the mortgage so satisfied is transcribed or recorded in a manner which permits
   notations to be made on the margin thereof, the recording officer shall note such
   satisfaction on the margin of the recorded mortgage and shall refer in such notation
   to the volume and page of the record wherein the satisfaction piece is set forth in
   full.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Mortgage Satisfaction Act›PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-2. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Mortgage Satisfaction Act › PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-2. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-2. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases when used in this act shall have the meanings given
   to them in this section unless the context clearly indicates otherwise:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Mortgage Satisfaction Act›PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-4. Satisfaction piece required and effect of satisfaction piece
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Mortgage Satisfaction Act › PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-4. Satisfaction piece required and effect of satisfaction piece
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-4. Satisfaction piece required and effect of satisfaction piece (2023)
content:
Every mortgagee shall, upon receipt of payment of the entire mortgage obligation and
   tender of all required satisfaction and recording costs, present for recording in
   the office where the mortgage is recorded a duly executed satisfaction piece in substantially
   the form set out in section 51and acknowledged as provided by law.  The satisfaction piece when recorded shall forever thereafter discharge, defeat
   and release the lien and debt of the mortgage.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Mortgage Satisfaction Act›PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-5. Form of satisfaction piece

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-5. Form of satisfaction piece (2023)
content:
Mortgagees, whether individuals or legal entities other than individuals, shall satisfy
   mortgages by a satisfaction piece in substantially the following form:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Mortgage Satisfaction Act›PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-1. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages › Chapter 2. Mortgages › Mortgage Satisfaction Act › PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-1. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-1. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the Mortgage Satisfaction Act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 21 P.S. Deeds and Mortgages›Chapter 2. Mortgages›Mortgage Satisfaction Act›PA ST 21 P.S. § 721-3. Satisfactions, methods and indexing
