title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (a). Definitions › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1101. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1101. Definitions (2023)
content: As used in this article,

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Article XI. Professional Employes›Subarticle (g). Military Service in Time of War or National Emergency›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1184. National Guard or Reserve parent student support
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Article XI. Professional Employes › Subarticle (g). Military Service in Time of War or National Emergency › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1184. National Guard or Reserve parent student support
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1184. National Guard or Reserve parent student support (2023)
content:
(a) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a student shall be afforded the same
      rights as a compact student of an active duty military family under the act of February
      2, 2012 (P.L. 42, No. 6),1known as the Interstate Compact on Educational Opportunity for Military Children
      Act, if a parent of the student is required to move to perform the parent's responsibilities
      in the service of the National Guard or Reserve resulting in the student having to
      transfer from a public school in one state to a public school located in this Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Article XI. Professional Employes›Subarticle (g). Military Service in Time of War or National Emergency›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1183. Military parent student support
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Article XI. Professional Employes › Subarticle (g). Military Service in Time of War or National Emergency › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1183. Military parent student support
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1183. Military parent student support (2023)
content:
(a) Beginning with the 2018-2019 school year and each school year thereafter, each
      public school entity shall provide appropriate support services, as specified in subsection
      (b), to students whose parent or guardian is a member of the armed forces being called
      to and while serving on active duty.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Article XI. Professional Employes›Subarticle (i). Programs›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1195. Distinguished Educators Program
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Article XI. Professional Employes › Subarticle (i). Programs › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1195. Distinguished Educators Program
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1195. Distinguished Educators Program (2023)
content:
(a) The Department of Education shall establish a Distinguished Educators Program
      for organizing individuals into a State corps of educators for the purpose of making
      them available throughout this Commonwealth to help eligible school districts and
      schools improve the quality of education.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1108. Temporary professional employes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1108. Temporary professional employes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1108. Temporary professional employes (2023)
content:
(a) It shall be the duty of the district superintendent to notify each temporary professional
      employe, at least twice each year during the period of his or her employment, of the
      professional quality, professional progress, and rating of his or her services.  No temporary professional employe shall be dismissed unless rated unsatisfactory,
      and notification, in writing, of such unsatisfactory rating shall have been furnished
      the employe within ten (10) days following the date of such rating.  The rating of a temporary professional employe shall be done as provided in section
      one thousand one hundred twenty-three of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1107. Special teachers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1107. Special teachers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1107. Special teachers (2023)
content:
The board of school directors in every school district may employ such special teachers,
   including special teachers who speak the idiomatic or colloquial language of immigrants
   residing in the school district, for the purpose of easing the transition period of
   such immigrants, qualified as herein provided, as they may deem necessary for any
   of the public schools or departments thereof in the district.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1106. Duty to employ
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1106. Duty to employ
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1106. Duty to employ (2023)
content:
The board of school directors in every school district shall employ the necessary
   qualified professional employes, substitutes and temporary professional employes to
   keep the public schools open in their respective districts in compliance with the
   provisions of this act.  Except for school districts of the first class and first class A which may require
   residency requirements for other than professional employes, substitutes and temporary
   professional employes, no other school district shall require an employe to reside
   within the school district as a condition for appointment or continued employment.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109. Qualifications
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109. Qualifications
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109. Qualifications (2023)
content:
(a) Every teacher employed to teach in the public schools of this Commonwealth must
      be a person of good moral character, must be at least eighteen years of age, and must
      be a citizen of the United States or authorized to work in the United States:  Provided,
      That citizenship may be waived in the case of exchange teachers not permanently employed,
      and teachers employed for the purpose of teaching foreign languages, including special
      teachers who speak the idiomatic or colloquial language of immigrants residing in
      the school district, and employed for the purpose of easing the transition period
      of such immigrants.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1111. Employment of relatives of school directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1111. Employment of relatives of school directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1111. Employment of relatives of school directors (2023)
content:
No teacher shall be employed, by any board of school directors, who is related to
   any member of the board;  as father, mother, brother, sister, husband, wife, son,
   daughter, stepson, stepdaughter, grandchild, nephew, niece, first cousin, sister-in-law,
   brother-in-law, uncle, or aunt, unless such teacher receives the affirmative votes
   of a majority of all members of the board other than the member related to the applicant
   who shall not vote.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109.1. Emergency certification in certain instances
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109.1. Emergency certification in certain instances
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109.1. Emergency certification in certain instances (2023)
content:
When the superintendent and board of education of a school district of the first class
   find that the supply of certified teachers is inadequate to the educational needs
   of the district's language minority student population or that the loss of teachers
   due to early retirement would cause the interruption of suitable and essential programs
   of instruction for such students, the district may hire otherwise qualified persons
   without current teaching certificates, provided that individuals so employed shall
   enroll in a teacher certification program and meet Pennsylvania certification requirements
   within a period not to exceed three (3) years.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109.2. Conditional employment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109.2. Conditional employment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1109.2. Conditional employment (2023)
content:
(a) A board of school directors may enter into an agreement to employ an individual
      as a temporary professional employe who, within six months of the date of expected
      graduation from an approved Pennsylvania college or university, presents a letter
      verifying that the individual is enrolled in an approved teacher preparation program
      in that institution and will complete all requirements for the conferring of a bachelor's
      degree on a date certain as specified.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1114. Day-to-day substitutes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1114. Day-to-day substitutes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1114. Day-to-day substitutes (2023)
content: (a) The following shall apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1113. Transferred programs and classes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1113. Transferred programs and classes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1113. Transferred programs and classes (2023)
content:
(a) When a program or class is transferred as a unit from one or more school entities
      to another school entity or entities, professional employes who were assigned to the
      class or program immediately prior to the transfer and are classified as teachers
      as defined in section 1141(1)1and are suspended as a result of the transfer and who are properly certificated shall
      be offered employment in the program or class by the receiving entity or entities
      when services of a professional employe are needed to sustain the program or class
      transferred, as long as there is no suspended professional employe in the receiving
      entity who is properly certificated to fill the position in the transferred class
      or program.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (b). Employment›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1115. Locally titled positions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (b). Employment › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1115. Locally titled positions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1115. Locally titled positions (2023)
content:
In a school district where an appointment under section 695-A1has been made at any time, an individual employed by a school district prior to January
   1, 2012, and serving in the position of mental health specialist, behavioral specialist
   or similar locally titled position may continue to serve in that position under the
   direct supervision of a Certified School Social Worker as long as the individual remains
   in the position with the same school district.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1122. Causes for termination of contract
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1122. Causes for termination of contract
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1122. Causes for termination of contract (2023)
content:
(a) The only valid causes for termination of a contract heretofore or hereafter entered
      into with a professional employe shall be immorality;  incompetency;  unsatisfactory
      teaching performance based on two (2) consecutive ratings of the employe's teaching
      performance that are to include classroom observations, not less than four (4) months
      apart, in which the employe's teaching performance is rated as unsatisfactory;  intemperance;
      cruelty;  persistent negligence in the performance of duties;  wilful neglect of duties;
      physical or mental disability as documented by competent medical evidence, which after
      reasonable accommodation of such disability as required by law substantially interferes
      with the employe's ability to perform the essential functions of his employment; 
      advocation of or participating in un-American or subversive doctrines;  conviction
      of a felony or acceptance of a guilty plea or nolo contendere therefor;  persistent
      and wilful violation of or failure to comply with school laws of this Commonwealth,
      including official directives and established policy of the board of directors;  on
      the part of the professional employe:  Provided, That boards of school directors may
      terminate the service of any professional employe who has attained to the age of sixty-two
      except a professional employe who is a member of the old age and survivors insurance
      system pursuant to the provisions of the act, approved the first day of June, one
      thousand nine hundred fifty-six (Pamphlet Laws 1973).1In such case the board may terminate the service of any such professional employe
      at the age of sixty-five or at the age at which the employe becomes eligible to receive
      full benefits under the Federal Social Security Act.2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1124. Causes for suspension
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1124. Causes for suspension
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1124. Causes for suspension (2023)
content:
(a) Any board of school directors may suspend the necessary number of professional
      employes, for any of the causes hereinafter enumerated:

content:

      professional employe's current position:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1121. Contracts; execution; form
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1121. Contracts; execution; form
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1121. Contracts; execution; form (2023)
content:
(a) In all school districts, all contracts with professional employes shall be in
      writing, in duplicate, and shall be executed on behalf of the board of school directors
      by the president and secretary and signed by the professional employe.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1128. Subpoenas; testimony
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1128. Subpoenas; testimony
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1128. Subpoenas; testimony (2023)
content:
The board shall have power to issue subpoenas requiring the attendance of witnesses
   at any hearing and shall do so at the request of the party against whom a complaint
   is made.  If any person shall refuse to appear and testify in answer to any subpoena issued
   by the board, any party interested may petition the court of common pleas of the county
   setting forth the facts, which court shall thereupon issue its subpoena commanding
   such person to appear before it, there to testify as to the matters being inquired
   into.  Any person refusing to testify before the court shall be held for contempt.  All testimony at any hearing shall be taken under oath, and any member of the board
   of school directors shall have power to administer oaths to such witnesses.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1126. Public hearings; exceptions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1126. Public hearings; exceptions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1126. Public hearings; exceptions (2023)
content:
All hearings, under the provisions of this article or any other provision of the school
   laws pertaining to the dismissal or the termination of contracts of professional employes,
   shall be public, unless otherwise requested by the party against whom the complaint
   is made.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1129. Vote required for dismissals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1129. Vote required for dismissals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1129. Vote required for dismissals (2023)
content:
After fully hearing the charges or complaints and hearing all witnesses produced by
   the board and the person against whom the charges are pending, and after full, impartial
   and unbiased consideration thereof, the board of school directors shall by a two-thirds
   vote of all the members thereof, to be recorded by roll call, determine whether such
   charges or complaints have been sustained and whether the evidence substantiates such
   charges and complaints, and if so determined shall discharge such professional employe.  If less than two-thirds of all of the members of the board vote in favor of discharge,
   the professional employe shall be retained and the complaint shall be dismissed.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.3. Classroom teachers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.3. Classroom teachers

content:

      employee serving as a classroom teacher in a building where annual building-level
      data is made available by the department shall be weighted and calculated accordingly:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1127. Procedure on dismissals; charges; notice; hearing
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1127. Procedure on dismissals; charges; notice; hearing
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1127. Procedure on dismissals; charges; notice; hearing (2023)
content:
Before any professional employe having attained a status of permanent tenure is dismissed
   by the board of school directors, such board of school directors shall furnish such
   professional employe with a detailed written statement of the charges upon which his
   or her proposed dismissal is based and shall conduct a hearing.  A written notice signed by the president and attested by the secretary of the board
   of school directors shall be forwarded by registered mail to the professional employe
   setting forth the time and place when and where such professional employe will be
   given an opportunity to be heard either in person or by counsel, or both, before the
   board of school directors and setting forth a detailed statement of the charges.  Such hearing shall not be sooner than ten (10) days nor later than fifteen (15)
   days after such written notice.  At such hearing all testimony offered, including that of complainants and their
   witnesses, as well as that of the accused professional employe and his or her witnesses,
   shall be recorded by a competent disinterested public stenographer whose services
   shall be furnished by the school district at its expense.  Any such hearing may be postponed, continued or adjourned.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1131. Appeals to Secretary of Education
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1131. Appeals to Secretary of Education
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1131. Appeals to Secretary of Education (2023)
content:
In case the professional employe concerned considers himself or herself aggrieved
   by the action of the board of school directors, an appeal by petition, setting forth
   the grounds for such appeal, may be taken to the Secretary of Education at Harrisburg.  Such appeal shall be filed within fifteen (15) days after receipt by registered
   mail of the written notice of the decision of the board.  A copy of such appeal shall be served by registered mail on the secretary of the
   school board.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.2. State rating tool
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.2. State rating tool
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.2. State rating tool (2023)
content:
In determining whether a professional employee shall be dismissed for unsatisfactory
   teaching performance as provided for in section 1122(a),1and in rating professional employees and temporary professional employees, each professional
   employee and temporary professional employee shall be rated through the use of a rating
   tool approved by the department in consultation with education experts, parents of
   school-age children enrolled in a public school, teachers and administrators, including
   research and collaboration conducted by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1132. Appeals to court
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1132. Appeals to court
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1132. Appeals to court (2023)
content:
The ruling or decision of the Secretary of Education shall be final, unless, an appeal
   is taken in accordance with the provisions of the act of June 4, 1945 (P.L. 1388,
   No. 442), known as the “Administrative Agency Law.”1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1133. Collective bargaining for public employes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1133. Collective bargaining for public employes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1133. Collective bargaining for public employes (2023)
content:
Nothing contained in sections 1121 through 11321shall be construed to supersede or preempt a provision of a collective bargaining
   agreement in effect on July 23, 1970, or on any date subsequent thereto, negotiated
   by a school entity and an exclusive representative of the employes in accordance with
   the act of July 23, 1970 (P.L. 563, No. 195), known as the “Public Employe Relations
   Act,”2which agreement provides for the right of the exclusive representative to grieve
   and arbitrate the validity of a professional employe's termination for just cause
   or for the causes set forth in section 11223of this act;  however, no agreement shall prohibit the right of a professional employe
   from exercising his or her rights under the provisions of this act except as herein
   provided.  However, if within ten (10) days after the receipt of the detailed written statement
   and notice as required by section 1127,4the professional employe chooses to exercise his or her right to a hearing, any provision
   of the collective bargaining agreement relative to the right of the exclusive representative
   to grieve or arbitrate the termination of such professional employe shall be void.  Professional employes shall have the right to file a grievance under the collective
   bargaining agreement or request a hearing pursuant to section 1121 through 1132, but
   not both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.6. Local rating tools
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.6. Local rating tools
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.6. Local rating tools (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding sections 1138.2, 1138.3, 1138.4 and 1138.5,1professional employees and temporary professional employees serving as classroom
   teachers, principals and nonteaching professional employees may be evaluated through
   the use of a rating tool developed by an individual school district, intermediate
   unit or area career and technical school that the department has approved as meeting
   or exceeding the measures of effectiveness established under this subarticle.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.10. Reporting
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.10. Reporting
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.10. Reporting (2023)
content:
Each school district, intermediate unit and area career and technical school shall
   provide to the department the aggregate results of all evaluations of professional
   employees and temporary professional employees, principals and nonteaching professional
   employees.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.7. Overall performance rating
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.7. Overall performance rating
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.7. Overall performance rating (2023)
content:
(a) Identification.--Each rating tool developed or approved under this subarticle shall identify the overall
      performance rating of the professional employees and temporary professional employees
      serving as classroom teachers, principals and nonteaching professional employees as
      one of the following:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.5. Nonteaching professional employees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.5. Nonteaching professional employees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.5. Nonteaching professional employees (2023)
content:
(a) Evaluation.--Beginning in the 2021-2022 school year, professional employees employed as nonteaching
      professionals shall be evaluated using a rating tool designed specifically for nonteaching
      professional employees which shall be determined in the following manner:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.1. Definitions

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.1. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases when used in this subarticle shall have the meanings
   given to them in this section unless the context clearly indicates otherwise:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.4. Principals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.4. Principals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.4. Principals (2023)
content:
(a) Evaluation.--Beginning in the 2021-2022 school year, the evaluation of the effectiveness of a professional
      employee serving as a principal in a building where annual building-level data is
      made available by the department shall be calculated with 70% of the overall rating
      reflected in the areas of planning and preparation, school environment, delivery of
      service and professional development utilizing a rating tool approved by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (c). Tenure›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1130. Notice of discharge; procedure on decision favorable to employe
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (c). Tenure › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1130. Notice of discharge; procedure on decision favorable to employe
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1130. Notice of discharge; procedure on decision favorable to employe (2023)
content:
A written notice of any decision of the board of school directors discharging a professional
   employe, shall be sent by registered mail to such professional employe at his or her
   last known address within ten (10) days after such hearing is actually concluded.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.9. Operative provisions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.9. Operative provisions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.9. Operative provisions (2023)
content:
The following shall apply to the ratings of each professional employee and temporary
   professional employee:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.15. Applicability
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.15. Applicability
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.15. Applicability (2023)
content:
The requirements of this subarticle shall apply to each school district, intermediate
   unit and area career and technical school.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.8. Rating tool
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.8. Rating tool
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.8. Rating tool (2023)
content:
(a) Discontinuation.--Beginning with the 2021-2022 school year, the rating form under22 Pa. Code § 351.21(relating to rating form) and any alternative rating forms approved under22 Pa. Code Ch. 351(relating to teacher tenure hearings) prior to the implementation of this subarticle
      shall be discontinued for use in the evaluation of professional and temporary professional
      employees.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.12. State regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.12. State regulations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.12. State regulations (2023)
content: The State Board of Education may develop regulations consistent with this subarticle.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.16. Report
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.16. Report
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.16. Report (2023)
content:
The department shall review the revised rating system within five years of the effective
   date of this section and shall submit a report of its findings to the Education Committee
   of the Senate and the Education Committee of the House of Representatives.  The report shall include a specific review of the accuracy of data collected by
   the department for the economically disadvantaged status of students as reported by
   a school district, intermediate unit or area career and technical school through the
   Pennsylvania Information Management System (PIMS).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.13. Collective bargaining agreements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.13. Collective bargaining agreements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.13. Collective bargaining agreements (2023)
content:
A collective bargaining agreement negotiated by a school district and an exclusive
   representative of the employees in accordance with the act of July 23, 1970 (P.L.
   563, No. 195),1known as the Public Employe Relations Act, after the effective date of this section
   may not provide for a rating system other than as provided for under this subarticle.  A provision in an agreement or contract in effect on the effective date of this
   section that provides for a rating system in conflict with this subarticle shall be
   discontinued in a new or renewed agreement or contract or during the period of status
   quo following an expired contract.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949›Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System›PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.11. Exemption from other laws
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 1. Public School Code of 1949 › Subarticle (C.1). Revised Rating System › PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.11. Exemption from other laws
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 11-1138.11. Exemption from other laws (2023)
content:
(a) Exemption.--Any rating tool developed by the department under this subarticle shall be exempt
      from:
